item.title: Beyond the Notebook: A Deep Dive into Databricks' Lakehouse Architecture and Photon Engine
item.description:
Databricks has become synonymous with the Lakehouse, democratizing data engineering, ML, and analytics. But what truly makes it tick beneath the surface? This isn’t another ‘getting started’ guide. We’re peeling back the layers to explore the architectural bedrock, the performance-boosting engines, and the practical challenges of building robust data solutions on Databricks.

## Understanding the Databricks Lakehouse Architecture
At its core, the Databricks Lakehouse Platform unifies data warehousing and data lakes, built upon the open-source Delta Lake storage layer.
